summary:
Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py, placed after print and before print_exception. It joins str() of each object with sep, then calls self.print once with end, style, highlight, emoji=False, markup=False, no_wrap=True, overflow="ignore", and crop=False. Default highlight is True.

Also added: a CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under Unreleased/Added; a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after the logging section; and tests in tests/test_console.py (RenderHook added to the existing import, new test_out* tests after test_print_style, including test_out for the five-copy width-10 example).

Not run: per instructions, no tests or repository code were executed, so everything is verified by reading only. Highlight tests assert only the presence or absence of escape sequences, and the style test reuses the expected bytes from test_print_style without tracing them. No commits were made.
